turns: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?

expect.answer: At least 75% attendance in each course (full attendance expected); below 75% without valid reason the instructor can recommend de-registration (Circular 51, 2024, supersedes the old rule).

turns: What happens if I am absent from all classes for four weeks in a semester?

expect.answer: Absence from all academic activities for 4+ weeks (with or without leave) results in automatic semester withdrawal / cancellation of registration.

turns: I missed a minor exam because I was sick. How do I apply for a make-up exam?

expect.answer: Make-up is for a missed Minor; submit the Makeup/I-grade application (Annexure A) with a medical certificate issued/verified by the IITJ Medical Officer to the Office of Academic Affairs within 10 days.

turns: What should I do if I miss the Major exam due to illness?

expect.answer: Apply for an I grade (not a make-up); the I grade application must reach the Office of Academic Affairs before the last day of the examinations, with a verified medical certificate.
